bias: 'An election night reversal for the ages. Now comes the real test.' After the early-evening LAAF both broke their boxes lower with continuation — ES to 7490 at the YTD-low AVWAP just under 7497-7504 (he'd warned against aggressive shorts into 7480-7520), NQ to the May low and 27592-27622 — then staged massive reversals as hedges were monetized and unwound (vol crush), ES opening RTH on a true gap higher; the first 5-minute OR set the RTH low in both and was never revisited. 'I could find myself extremely bullish OR bearish on price by Friday.' Reserving bigger-picture judgment for a couple of days.
